changes: Added PSX Puppet family: 723 triangles, 7 bones, 2 skinned meshes, 1 material, 32 source animation clips.
PSX Puppet is driven entirely from manifest fields for proportions, face wraps, animation clips and stepped motion.
Face portraits are public-domain Wikimedia images and map onto the actual head mesh UV, never a floating plane.
PETIT/NORMAL/ALTO/ANCHO reuse one rig and one geometry by scaling named bones.
Stepped animation quantizes playback time to 15/12/10/6 FPS without changing the source clips.
The existing viewer remains catalog-driven; advanced controls are created only when the manifest declares them.
